record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: central limit theorem for equilibrium states
record.original_question: Show that μ_φ satisfies the central limit theorem for Hölder continuous observables.

evidence.quote: Problem 5. — Show that µϕ satisfies the CLT for Hölder continuous observables.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}^2$ be a complex Hénon map, i.e. a finite composition of generalized Hénon maps of the form $(x,y)\mapsto (y,\,p(y)-\delta x)$ with $p\in\mathbb{C}[y]$ of degree at least $2$ and $\delta\in\mathbb{C}^*$. Let $K^\pm$ denote the forward/backward filled Julia sets of $f$ and let $K=K^+\cap K^-$ be the (compact) set of points with bounded forward and backward orbits. Let $\varphi:K\to\mathbb{R}$ be a Hölder continuous potential of small enough oscillation (so that the variational principle yields a unique equilibrium state), and let $\mu_\varphi$ be the unique invariant probability measure on $K$ maximizing the pressure functional
$$h_\mu(f)+\int \varphi\,d\mu$$
over all $f$-invariant Borel probability measures.

Prove that $\mu_\varphi$ satisfies the Central Limit Theorem for Hölder continuous observables: for every Hölder continuous function $g:K\to\mathbb{R}$ with $\int g\,d\mu_\varphi=0$ that is not a coboundary, there exists $\sigma>0$ such that
$$\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} g\circ f^k \;\xrightarrow{\;d\;}\; \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2)$$
in distribution under $\mu_\varphi$, where $\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^2)$ denotes the centered Gaussian law of variance $\sigma^2$.
artifact.category_tag: Equilibrium states for complex Hénon maps
artifact.status_search_result: The CLT for Hölder observables is known for the measure of maximal entropy of every complex Hénon map (Bianchi–Dinh, Forum of Math. Sigma), and the CLT has been extended to plurisubharmonic observables for that measure (Bianchi–Dinh, arXiv:2407.15418). For general equilibrium states $\mu_\varphi$ associated with Hölder potentials, no result establishing the CLT for all Hölder observables on every complex Hénon map appears in the literature, so the problem as posed for general $\mu_\varphi$ appears to remain open in this generality, while being solved for the special case $\varphi\equiv 0$.

status_evidence.title: Every complex Hénon map is exponentially mixing of all orders and satisfies the CLT
status_evidence.snippet: The measure of maximal entropy of every complex Hénon map satisfies the CLT for Hölder observables.
status_evidence.claim: CLT for Hölder observables is established for the measure of maximal entropy of every complex Hénon map.

status_evidence.title: Mixing and CLT for Hénon-Sibony maps: plurisubharmonic observables
status_evidence.snippet: All plurisubharmonic functions satisfy the CLT with respect to the measure of maximal entropy of every Hénon–Sibony map on C^k.
status_evidence.claim: CLT extended to plurisubharmonic observables for the measure of maximal entropy; general equilibrium states μ_φ for Hölder potentials are not addressed.
